name: Small exploratory VNS mechanism ablation
purpose: Mechanism screening, not a replacement for the formal experiment
selection: Preselected by family, layer count, threshold and perturbation; no outcome-based selection
initialization: One archived Greedy solution (seed 24680) per configuration, shared by all versions and all three new search seeds

variant_definitions.full: Original VNS-G-FI search from an injected feasible Greedy incumbent
variant_definitions.no-repair-deficit: Only repair ranking changes from (U,D,weight) to (U,weight); deficit-based layer tie selection, general search key and Greedy fallback are unchanged
variant_definitions.fixed-tie: Only adaptive tie-probability updates are disabled; probability remains 0.4

time_scope: Search including initial local search, but excluding archived Greedy construction and input loading
stopping: Same original 10000-iteration and 5000-no-improvement limits; original repair may overrun wall limit, actual elapsed is recorded
schedule: Fixed shuffled configuration-seed blocks, variants rotated cyclically within blocks

incremental_benchmark.comparison: Cached trial evaluation and rollback versus independent full adjacency scan on the identical trace; alternate timing order and warm up both paths
